howto: You are X. Tap an empty square.
Get three in a row across, down or corner to corner before the bot does.
tips: Take the centre first: it sits on four winning lines.
If the bot takes the centre, answer with a corner, never an edge.
Two open lines at once (a fork) is the only way to beat Hard.
Stuck? Hint shows the square that keeps the most lines open.

controls.keyboard: Tab to a square, Enter to play it. P or Esc pauses.
controls.touch: Tap a square. Undo and Hint sit under the board.

difficulty: Easy plays a random square about two times in three; Hard plays perfectly, so a draw is a good result.

cheats.effect: The bot naps: you move twice, three times
See the square the bot wants next (orange outline)
Wipe the score board back to 0-0-0

features.rules-screen: The intro card on first play (and Exit to title), plus Pause > How to play
features.ai-difficulty: Easy and Hard switch under the board
features.undo: Undo takes back your last move and the bot's reply
features.results: The status line says who won, the winning line pulses, and the score board updates
